{{Top|leg}}
A '''hover-raft''' was a small surface effect which was propelled by [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]]. It consisted of a protective [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] bubble for the operator and a flatbed used for hauling cargo.
